'''Howie''' (Japanese: '''ヒロヲ''' ''Hiro'o'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG176|The Ole' Berate and Switch!]]''. He is a {{pkmn|Trainer}} from [[Sable City]].

He was the first Trainer that {{Ash}} and his {{AP|Corphish}} battled in a fake tournament organized by [[Team Rocket]] agents [[Butch]] and [[Cassidy]].

Howie's {{p|Pinsir}} battled well and used {{m|Vise Grip}}, {{m|Guillotine}}, and {{m|Seismic Toss}} to weaken Corphish, but when his second Guillotine failed due to Corphish using {{m|Harden}} and then {{m|Bubble Beam}}, he lost.
